title: The world's largest economies
hook: Which countries have the biggest economies?

source.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators — GDP (current US$) (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD)
source.terms: World Bank data, CC BY 4.0 (https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/legal/terms-of-use-for-datasets); attribute 'World Bank, World Development Indicators'.
source.notes: WDI last updated 2026-07-13. Values converted to US$ bn (value/1e9). 79 aggregates dropped via region.id == "NA"; 214 economies kept (the list includes territories and SARs as the World Bank reports them). Coverage starts late for some large economies, so early years under-count: first year with data — Russian Federation 1988. The 2024 top 10 are all present from 1988 (recommendedStart). Predecessor states are absent: SUN, YUG, CSK, DDR are not in the WDI country list (no USSR, Yugoslavia, Czechoslovakia or East Germany series), so the Soviet economy never appears before the Russian Federation series starts; Germany (DEU) has values from 1960 as WDI publishes them, with no East/West split. No gaps inside any entity's run.
